EN:
Not even the cold can keep you
down, huh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
ES:
Ni siquiera el frío puede detenerte,
¿eh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
Le froid ça ne t'arrête pas à ce que
je vois,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
Nemmeno il freddo riesce
a fermarti, eh, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
DE:
Die Kälte scheint dir ja nichts
auszumachen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's freezing!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm all for
chilling out, but this is a little bit
much,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Qué frío!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yo siempre soy
partidario de tomar el fresco,
¡pero esto es demasiado!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} En général j'essaie de garder
la tête froide en toute circonstance,
mais là...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Trop froid, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Si gela!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Chissà perché dicono
"sudare freddo",{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
Magari sudassi un po' adesso!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es ist eisig heute!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich wäre
zwar gerne cool, aber so cool auch
wieder nicht,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Buz kestim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ben keyif yapıp
serinlemeyi severim ama bu kadarı
fazla, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
La neige ça ressemble à du sucre
glace...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Miam... J'ai très envie de la
lécher maintenant, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Der Schnee sieht aus wie
Zuckerwatte,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Schau endlich weg, damit ich
ihn probieren kann!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ma tête est si froide que j'ai
l'impression d'être un cornet de
glace à une boule,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Fa talmente freddo
che non mi sento più
la faccia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Brrr!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Suratım o kadar soğudu ki
hissetmiyorum bile, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Snow days just make me want to
pelt everyone with snowballs. You'd
better watch out,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Los días de nieve me dan ganas de
machacar a la gente con bolas de
nieve. ¡Ve con ojo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando nevica, mi viene voglia
di bersagliare la gente con le palle
di neve.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Fossi in te, terrei gli occhi aperti,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mich juckt es in den Fingern,
jemanden mit Schneebällen zu
bewerfen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kar yağınca herkesi kar topuna
tutasım geliyor. Sen de tetikte ol,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
